description: This file implements the MediaFrameWriterFactory class, which creates instances of media frame writers (V1 or V2) based on a versioning environment variable. It includes logic for handling environment variables, exception handling, and factory pattern implementation.

classes.name: MediaFrameWriterFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating media frame writer instances based on metadata version.

classes.name: IMediaFrameWriterFactory
classes.description: Interface for media frame writer factory.

methods.name: IMediaFrameWriterFactory::getFactory
methods.description: Static method to obtain a shared pointer to the factory instance.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterFactory::MediaFrameWriterFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory, reading the metadata version from environment variable.

methods.name: MediaFrameWriterFactory::createFrameWriter
methods.description: Creates a media frame writer object (V1 or V2) based on the current metadata version.
